mapper.sql: id, operation_id, domain, operation_type, import_data_id, batch_num, original_import_data_id, payload_digest, request_digest, plan_digest, plan_json, operator_id, operator_name, operation_source, reason, ticket_no, status, counters_json, legacy_replay_id, lease_owner, lease_until, fence_token, created_at, started_at, finished_at, description, create_time, create_by, modify_time, modify_by, row_version, row_valid
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_import_operation SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, fence_token = fence_token + 1, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, #{leaseUntil}), row_version = row_version + 1, modify_time = now() WHERE operation_id = #{operationId} AND row_valid = 1 AND ( (status = 'PENDING') OR (status = 'RECOVERING' AND lease_until < #{now}) )

UPDATE tb_import_operation SET lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, row_version = row_version + 1, modify_time = now() WHERE operation_id = #{operationId} AND row_valid = 1 AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE tb_import_operation SET status = #{status}, counters_json = #{countersJson}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1, modify_time = now() WHERE operation_id = #{operationId} AND row_valid = 1 AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'RECOVERING')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_import_operation t WHERE t.row_valid = 1 AND t.status = 'RUNNING' AND t.lease_until < #{now} ORDER BY t.lease_until ASC LIMIT 100
